correctness.rationale: For q>=4 every vertex degree is 2q. Reconstructed the root-neighbor incidence count: for S with minimum internal degree q and v in S, coordinate-clique populations a<=2,b,c<=q-1, k=a+b+c>=q, B=S\({v}U A), and 2|B|>=qk-a^2-b^2-c^2. Convexity maximizes the square sum at (q-1,r,0), r=k-q+1, forcing |S|>=2q and equality only r=1 with full q-coordinate and one cross-direction, hence q-by-2-by-1 rectangles. Their count is 3q(q+1). Pairing the 3-by-q base grid, with an odd-q final three-cell column, yields floor(3q/2) full-coordinate colour classes and matches the size bound. Independent integer exhaustive checks over local (a,b,c) combinations, the complete rectangle census, and explicit majority partitions for q=4..14 passed; the proof supplies all q.
